name: ESSEC Business School
summary: Business school at Cergy, west of Paris; a four-year English Global BBA and a new AI, data and management BSc with CentraleSupélec.

ib.text: Apply with the IB as an international high-school diploma: transcripts of the last 3 years, English test (IELTS 6.5 or TOEFL iBT 90) unless taught in English, then an interview.

dates.label: Global BBA round 1 closes, noon Paris time; results by 7 December
Global BBA round 1 interviews begin (to 1 December)
Global BBA round 2 closes, noon Paris time; results by 26 February
Global BBA round 2 interviews begin (to 17 February)
Global BBA round 3 closes, noon Paris time; results by 21 April
Global BBA round 3 interviews begin (to 13 April)
Global BBA round 4 (last) closes, noon Paris time; results by 2 June
Global BBA round 4 interviews begin (to 26 May)

programmes.name: Global BBA
programmes.about: A four-year management degree with 10 to 12 months of internships and at least six months abroad at a partner university; the English track starts in Cergy (or Singapore).
programmes.ib: English test unless your last two school years were taught in English: IELTS 6.5, TOEFL iBT 90 or TOEIC 850.
programmes.selectionNote: The whole file is scored; shortlisted applicants have a 30-minute motivational interview with two examiners.

programmes.name: BSc in Artificial Intelligence, Data & Management Sciences
programmes.about: Run jointly with the engineering school CentraleSupélec: mathematical modelling, data science and computer science with a generalist base in management, taught 100% in English, with 9 months of internships.
programmes.ib: Includes a mathematics test; English test as for the Global BBA. 2027 dates not yet published.
programmes.selectionNote: File, a mathematics test, then an interview for those shortlisted.

notes: One application per programme per year, and at most two applications to the same programme in total.
Application fee €100; a €5,500 deposit, taken off the tuition, confirms a place.
French-bac holders enter through the SESAME exam or Parcoursup; an IB student applies on ESSEC's own portal.
